facts.fact: The report says the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education implements the DHIS2-based EMIS, begun in 2018.
The report says daily attendance reporting and individual-level learner records were added to the ministry's DHIS2-based EMIS; it does not say at which schools or levels.

DHIS2 reports that the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education launched its Education Data Center, a public DHIS2 portal consolidating the annual school census, attendance reporting and other sources, with an early warning system for drop-out risk being built on it.
